entries.title: II Chronicles 29:1
segments: Hezekiah began to reign [being] twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother's name [was] Abijah the daughter of Zechariah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:2
segments: And he did the right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father had done.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:3
segments: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the LORD and repaired them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:4
segments: And [he] brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them into the east street.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:5
segments: And he said to them, Hear me, Levites, now sanctify yourselves and sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry out the filthiness out of the holy [place].

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:6
segments: For our fathers have sinned and did the evil in the eyes of the LORD our God, and have forsaken Him, and have turned away their faces from the house of the LORD, and have turned [their] backs.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:7
segments: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:8
segments: Therefore the wrath of the LORD was on Judah and Jerusalem, and He has delivered them to trouble, to ruin, and to hissing as you see with your eyes.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:9
segments: For lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives [are] in captivity for this.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:10
segments: And [it is] in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that His fierce wrath may turn away from us.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:11
segments: My sons, do not be negligent now. For the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and that you should minister to Him and burn incense.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:12
segments: And the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites. And of the sons of Merari arose Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel. And of the Gershonites: Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:13
segments: And of the sons of Elizaphan: Shimri and Jeiel. And of the sons of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:14
segments: And of the sons of Heman: Jehiel and Shimei. And of the sons of Jeduthun: Shemaiah and Uzziel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:15
segments: And they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves, and came, according to the command of the king, by the words of the LORD, to clean the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:16
segments: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD to clean [it]. And they brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of the LORD into the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took [it]  out to the brook Kidron.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:17
segments: And they began to sanctify on the first of the first month. And on the eighth day of the month they came to the porch of the LORD. And they made the house of the LORD pure in eight days, and in the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:18
segments: And they went in to Hezekiah the king and said, We have cleaned all the house of the LORD, and the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and the showbread table, and all its vessels.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:19
segments: And we have prepared and sanctified all the vessels which king Ahaz in his reign cast away in his sin. And behold, they [are] before the altar of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:20
segments: And Hezekiah the king rose early and gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:21
segments: And they brought seven bulls and seven rams and seven lambs and seven he-goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom, and for the sanctuary, and for Judah. And he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer [them] on the altar of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:22
segments: And they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled [it] on the altar. And they killed the rams, and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs, and they sprinkled the blood on the altar.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:23
segments: And they brought out the he-goats [for] the sin offering before the king and the congregation. And they laid their hands on them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:24
segments: And the priest killed them, and they made atonement with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel. For the king commanded the burnt offering and the sin offering [to be made] for all Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:25
segments: And he set the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with harps, and with lyres, according to the command of David, and of Gad the king's seer and Nathan the prophet. For the commandment [was] by the hand of the LORD by His prophets.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:26
segments: And the Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:27
segments: And Hezekiah commanded to offer the burnt offering on the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD began with the trumpets and with the instruments [ordained] by David king of Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:28
segments: And all the congregation worshiped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded. All this [went on] until the burnt offering was finished.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:29
segments: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:30
segments: And Hezekiah the king and the rulers commanded the Levites to sing praise to the LORD with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:31
segments: And Hezekiah answered and said, And you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD. Come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings. And as many as were of a free heart [brought] burnt offerings.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:32
segments: And the number of the burnt offerings which the congregation brought was seventy oxen, a hundred rams, two hundred lambs. All these [were] for a burnt offering to the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:33
segments: And the things consecrated [were] six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:34
segments: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings. And their brothers the Levites helped them until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves. For the Levites [were] more upright of heart to make themselves pure than the priests.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:35
segments: And also the burnt offerings [were] in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and the drink offerings for [every] burnt offering. And the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:36
segments: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people. For the thing happened suddenly.
